title: BPBond 솔로 #074 · 누비안부티빌더 · Filipino Yakan painted pattern · 팔·몸통 체인 결박 · a sheer frosted pale-pink lip
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Swedish woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, very pale, cool skin, a soft white-silver highlighter along the cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones, pale icy-blue eyeshadow with a fine silver shimmer, pale softly brushed blonde brows, curled light-brown-tipped lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, a sheer frosted pale-pink lip, a cool, calm, faraway expression, cheerful, soft pastel-pink hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real living eyes. Long almond nails, holographic finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the front, side and rear deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps with a deep split between them, wide flaring lats, a deeply carved abdomen with sharp obliques, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep and a visible teardrop shape above each knee, thick hamstrings, and diamond-shaped calves. The waist is narrow only in contrast to the massive hips and shoulders. Every muscle group is separated by deep grooves and hard edges. Hard and muscular, not soft, not a plus-size body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern — a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands, wide magenta-and-gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric diamond work filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Restraints: She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs to a huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall at head height beside her. Her upper arms are pressed against her sides and bound to her torso with many tight turns of a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, wound around her ribcage and upper arms from just below her bust down to her waist, locked with a heavy iron padlock at her back, her forearms and hands free below the chain. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, outward to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall at hip height on its own side, her forearms angled slightly outward by the chains.

Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her hands held together in front of her hips, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: Extreme magenta-and-gold extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Background & Lighting: the dim torchlight and flickering light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
